summary.text: Branden Scrivener, a candidate with no party affiliation, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 12th Congressional District to Gus Bilirakis.
He is 27, has a bachelor's degree in human services and has worked in healthcare for over three years, per his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Scrivener graduated from Sunlake High School and earned an associate degree from Hillsborough Community College and a bachelor's degree from Indian River State College. The two reference sources differ on the degree years, so they are omitted here.
He has worked as a case manager assistant at AdventHealth since 2022, and before that was an assistant manager at Salt Life from 2019 to 2022, according to BallotReady.
Scrivener ran with no party affiliation. BallotReady lists his stances on education, government reform, infrastructure and wages, including support for an 8-year term limit for the House.
He received 1.3% of the vote to Gus Bilirakis's 52.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
